name: Devilled Kidneys
subtitle: lamb kidneys in a sharp, peppery sauce, eaten on toast at breakfast

ingredients.note: lamb kidney; soak 20 minutes in salted water and rinse

prepNotes: Devilled means hot and sharp: pepper, mustard and something acid. It is a breakfast dish and a fast one.
Kidneys are ruined by overcooking. Six minutes total, and they should still be pink at the centre.

steps.text: Soak the cored kidneys in salted water 20 minutes, then rinse and pat completely dry.
Melt the butter and soften the onion 5 minutes.
Raise the heat, add the kidneys and sear 2 minutes without moving them.
Add the pepper and chilli powder, toss 2 minutes, then the vinegar and cream.
Season, spoon over hot toast and scatter coriander.
steps.tip: Serve the moment it is done. Held warm, kidneys go grey and tough.

storage: Eat immediately. This does not keep or reheat.
